# CANDIDATE: PUT_CALL_EXTREME_REVERSAL_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extreme put/call ratio (>1.5) in the first 30 minutes indicates capitulation and exhaustion of selling pressure, creating a high-probability short-covering reversal to the upside. This edge exists because panic-driven put buying often marks a temporary imbalance that resolves via mean reversion as sellers cover and new buyers step in.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Between 9:30-10:00 EST, require: 0DTE put/call ratio > 1.5, price closes above 5EMA and above VWAP, 5EMA > 8EMA (bullish ribbon alignment), and no gap down > 0.5% from prior close.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the low of the entry bar (chart-stop). TP1 at 1R (risk-reward = 1). Runner position trails 10% below the high-water mark (HWM) until exit. Regime filter: VIX < 25 (implied but redundant with time window).
